text: In shotgun metagenomics, which tool assigns taxonomy to reads using exact k-mer matching against a reference database, rather than a curated set of marker genes?
explanation: Kraken2 performs taxonomic classification via exact k-mer matching against a reference database. MetaPhlAn3 instead relies on marker-gene-based profiling, HUMAnN3 estimates functional pathway abundance rather than taxonomy, and MEGAHIT is a metagenome assembler, not a taxonomic classifier.
